desc: Precompute the prefix sum array P[i][c] for all i in [0, n] and c in 'a'..'z', where P[i][c] is the total cost to convert s[0:i] to character c.
Initialize dp array of size n+1 with infinity, set dp[0]=0. Initialize best[c] and best_j[c] for each character c to infinity and -1 respectively.
Iterate i from 0 to n: if i>=3, update best[c] and best_j[c] using j=i-3; then if i>=3, compute dp[i] by trying all 26 characters using the maintained best values.
If dp[n] is infinity, return "". Otherwise, reconstruct the result string by backtracking from i=n using the stored choice_c and choice_j arrays.
